short_description: A standing yoga pose that stretches the hamstrings, hips and side body while building balance.
how_to: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Turn your right foot out and your left foot in slightly.
Reach your right arm down toward your right shin or the floor.
Extend your left arm straight up toward the ceiling.
Hold the position, then switch sides.
correct: Keep your hips open to the side.
Keep both legs straight.
Stack your shoulders vertically.
Breathe steadily.
mistakes: Don't force the stretch beyond your range.

short_description: A single-leg squat with rear foot elevated that targets the quads, glutes and hip flexors.
how_to: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing away from a bench.
Place one foot behind you on the bench.
Lower your back knee toward the floor by bending your front knee.
Push through your front heel to return to the start.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your chest tall throughout.
Keep your heels down on the working foot.
Move with control on the way down.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't let your front knee drift past your toes.

short_description: A cross-step lunge holding dumbbells that targets the glutes, quads and hip abductors.
how_to: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand tall.
Step one foot diagonally behind the other, crossing it behind your body.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push back up and return to the start position.
Alternate sides with each rep.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your chest lifted.
Keep your heels down on the standing foot.
Engage your core throughout.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't lean forward with your torso.
Don't let your front heel lift off the floor.

short_description: A chair-assisted stretch that opens the chest and releases tension in the shoulders.
how_to: Stand facing away from the chair and place both hands on the back of it.
Walk your feet forward and hinge at the hips until your torso is roughly parallel to the floor.
Let your chest drop gently toward the floor.
Hold where you feel a gentle stretch across your shoulders.
Breathe slowly and release.
correct: Keep your arms straight.
Keep your feet hip-width apart.
Relax your shoulders away from your ears.
Breathe steadily.

short_description: A hip-hinge pattern with dumbbells that strengthens the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
how_to: Hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and a soft bend in your knees.
Push your hips back and lower the dumbbells along your legs.
Stop when your torso is roughly parallel to the floor.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing.
correct: Keep your back flat throughout.
Keep the dumbbells close to your body.
Push your hips back, not your knees forward.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
mistakes: Don't let the weights drift away from your legs.
Don't lock your knees out hard.

short_description: A targeted neck and upper-shoulder stretch that relieves tightness in the levator scapulae muscle.
how_to: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head forward and rotate it about 45 degrees to one side.
Gently draw your chin down toward your armpit until you feel a stretch up the back of your neck.
Hold the position, then switch sides.
correct: Keep your shoulders down.
Apply only gentle pressure.
Breathe steadily throughout the hold.
Keep the rest of your body relaxed.
mistakes: Don't twist your torso to increase the pull.

short_description: A seated or lying knee-extension exercise that strengthens the quadriceps through a controlled range of motion.
how_to: Sit on a sturdy surface with your thigh supported and your lower leg hanging free.
Slowly straighten your knee until your leg is fully extended.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your leg back down in a controlled manner.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.
correct: Move at a slow, steady pace.
Keep your thigh still throughout.
Pause at full extension.
Keep your core lightly engaged.
mistakes: Don't swing your leg up with momentum.
Don't lock out your knee with force.

short_description: A weighted squat holding dumbbells that builds strength in the quads, glutes and hamstrings.
how_to: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and push your hips back.
Bend your knees to lower into a squat.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Press through your heels to return to standing.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your heels down throughout.
Keep your chest up and back flat.
Engage your core on the way down.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't let your heels lift off the floor.

short_description: A seated cross-legged side bend that stretches the obliques and lateral torso.
how_to: Sit on the floor with your legs crossed.
Place one hand on the floor beside your hip.
Reach your other arm up and over your head to the side.
Hold where you feel a stretch along your side.
Return to centre and repeat on the other side.
correct: Keep your sit bones grounded.
Reach long through your top arm.
Relax your neck and shoulders.
Breathe steadily.
mistakes: Don't lift your hip off the floor.

short_description: A quadruped hip-abduction exercise with a dumbbell that activates the glutes and hip abductors.
how_to: Place a dumbbell behind one knee and hold it in place by bending your knee.
Start on all fours with your wrists under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Keeping your knee bent at 90 degrees, lift that leg out to the side.
Raise until your thigh is parallel to the floor.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch sides.
correct: Keep your hips level throughout.
Keep your core engaged.
Move with control on both the lift and the lower.
Keep your weight balanced on your supporting limbs.
mistakes: Don't rotate your hips to swing the leg up.
Don't let your lower back arch.

short_description: A narrow-grip dumbbell press performed on a bench that emphasises the triceps and inner chest.
how_to: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest with palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Lower the dumbbells toward your lower chest in a controlled manner.
Press back up to the start position.
Repeat for the desired reps.
correct: Keep your body straight from head to hips.
Keep your elbows controlled and close.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Breathe out on the press.
mistakes: Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't bounce the weights off your chest.
Don't arch your lower back excessively.

short_description: A lateral lunge holding dumbbells that targets the inner thighs, glutes and quads.
how_to: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with your feet together.
Step one foot wide to the side and shift your weight over that leg.
Bend the stepping knee and push your hips back to lower into the lunge.
Keep your other leg straight.
Push back to the centre and repeat on the other side.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your heels down throughout.
Keep your chest up and back flat.
Keep your straight leg extended fully.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't let your heel lift off the floor.

short_description: A gentle lateral neck stretch that releases tightness in the neck and upper trapezius.
how_to: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head slowly to one side, bringing your ear toward your shoulder.
Hold where you feel a gentle stretch along the opposite side of your neck.
Return to centre and repeat on the other side.
correct: Keep your shoulders down and level.
Move slowly into the stretch.
Breathe steadily throughout.
Keep the rest of your body still.
mistakes: Don't raise your shoulder to meet your ear.
Don't jerk your head to the side.

short_description: A lying-down hamstring stretch that lengthens the back of the thigh with minimal strain on the lower back.
how_to: Lie on your back with both legs extended.
Bend one knee and loop a towel or your hands behind the thigh.
Straighten that leg toward the ceiling as much as your flexibility allows.
Hold the position, then switch legs.
correct: Keep your lower back flat on the floor.
Keep a slight bend in the stretching knee if needed.
Relax your foot and ankle.
Breathe slowly.
mistakes: Don't lift your hips off the floor.
Don't jerk your leg to increase range.

short_description: A shallow wall squat that strengthens the quads and glutes with joint-friendly range of motion.
how_to: Stand with your back flat against a wall and your feet hip-width apart.
Slide down the wall until your knees are bent about 45 degrees.
Hold that position for the required time.
Keep your heels pressed into the floor.
Slide back up to standing to finish.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your heels down throughout.
Keep your back flat against the wall.
Breathe steadily.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't drop too fast into the position.
Don't push your lower back away from the wall.

short_description: A lying core exercise that challenges lower-abdominal control by lowering one leg at a time.
how_to: Lie on your back with both legs raised to 90 degrees.
Brace your core and press your lower back into the floor.
Slowly lower one leg toward the floor without touching it.
Bring it back up and repeat with the other leg.
Alternate sides for the desired reps.
correct: Keep your lower back controlled and pressed down.
Move at a slow, deliberate pace.
Keep your non-working leg still.
Breathe steadily throughout.
mistakes: Don't let your lower back lift off the floor.

short_description: A weighted step-up onto a chair that builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.
how_to: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing a sturdy chair.
Place one foot fully on the seat of the chair.
Press through that heel to step up until both feet are on the chair.
Step back down with control, leading with the same foot.
Complete all reps, then switch the leading leg.
correct: Keep your chest tall throughout.
Keep your knee over your toes on the stepping leg.
Keep your heels down on the chair.
Move with control on the way down.
mistakes: Don't push off your back foot to cheat the step.
Don't let your knee cave inward.

short_description: A compound cardio move that combines mountain climbers with a squat thrust to work the core, legs and cardiovascular system.
how_to: Start in a high plank position with your hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then the other, for a set of mountain climbers.
Jump both feet toward your hands into a squat position.
Jump both feet back to the plank position.
Repeat the sequence at a controlled pace.
correct: Keep your hips level in the plank.
Keep your core engaged throughout.
Land softly with each foot movement.
Breathe rhythmically.
mistakes: Don't let your hips rise or sag in the plank.
Don't rush and lose your form.
Don't let your lower back arch.

short_description: A lying core exercise that brings opposite arms and legs together to challenge the abs and coordination.
how_to: Lie on your back with your arms and legs spread wide like a star.
Lift your head, shoulders and opposite arm and leg at the same time.
Crunch them toward each other at the centre.
Lower with control and switch to the other arm and leg.
Alternate sides with each rep.
correct: Keep your lower back controlled throughout.
Keep the movement smooth and deliberate.
Exhale as you crunch.
Keep your chin off your chest.
mistakes: Don't jerk your limbs up with momentum.

short_description: A crab-position kick that targets the triceps, glutes and core while improving hip extension.
how_to: Sit on the floor with your feet flat and your hands behind your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Press into your hands and feet to lift your hips off the floor.
Kick one leg straight up toward the ceiling.
Lower that foot back to the floor and alternate legs.
Keep your hips elevated throughout the set.
correct: Keep your hips level as you kick.
Keep your supporting arms straight.
Engage your core to stabilise.
Move with control on each kick.
mistakes: Don't let your hips sag toward the floor.
Don't swing your leg with excessive momentum.
Don't let your wrists collapse outward.
